title: 第二十八章 元鸦的礼物
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
“知彤，住手。”雷鹏急得离开座位，叫道。

    侯紫并没有动，面前一阵风起，那热气已吹得散了一些。

    “好，很好。”嚓的一声，热气忽然没了，剑已归鞘。雷知彤转身对着雷鹏一阵娇笑，“爹，我和马公子开个玩笑啦。”

    “胡闹。”雷鹏抱拳对侯紫说，“马公子，这是小女雷知彤，资质还行，是长霞峰掌门的真传弟子。以后大家多亲近亲近。”

    “爹—”雷知彤撒了下娇，“不理你了。”转身回了里屋。

    侯紫站起来说“雷帮主，那我就先告辞了。有事传讯，不必相送。”

    “好走，好走。”雷鹏拱手。

    侯紫转身回炼器铺去了。

    东城帮总舵里，雷知彤端坐正位，雷鹏站在下首。

    “此人不简单，一介凡人，并无灵力波动，却能驱散我所发出的火力。来历查明了没有？”雷知彤问。

    “秉家主，马侯是假名，真名侯紫，出身大靖王朝戈蓝国岳州城，孤儿，街头混混。一个月前，被岳州王通缉，据了解是因为两个云霄阁修士死在岳州城西山。具体原因不详。”

    雷鹏顿了下，接着说“侯紫被追杀进十万大山，半个月前出现在汉口镇和江陵城。然后跟韩弼时，其实叫沈君壁，往散修之家而来。沈君壁是原云霄阁附属家族沈家遗孤。在进坊市前遇原族人叛徒沈别鹤，杀之。至于侯紫在十万大山发生什么查证不到，只知道那段时间，云霄阁上界下派的筑基修士陆继死在了十万大山。”

    “筑基修士陆继？”雷知彤沉吟了下，对雷鹏吩咐道，“这侯紫的真实战力比肩筑基？这在下界怎么可能，其中必有蹊跷。也不能排除有这实力，在这下界也算难得，让他当客卿这步走对了，好好拉拢下，别坏了我们的大事。”

    居然没说到欧阳琦，难道被冰月真人抹去了痕迹。

    侯紫回到炼器铺，沈君壁迎了上去，上下打量，“还好，一点没少。”

    侯紫掏出东城帮客卿令牌，扔给沈君壁说，“嘿嘿，拿去玩。”
content_en:
"Zhitong, stop." Lei Peng left his seat in a hurry and shouted.

Hou Zi did not move. A gust of wind blew up in front of him, and the heat had dispersed a bit.

"Okay, very good." There was a sound, the heat suddenly disappeared, and the sword was sheathed.Lei Zhitong turned around and smiled sweetly at Lei Peng, "Dad, Mr. Ma and I were joking."

"Nonsense." Lei Peng cupped his fists and said to Hou Zi, "Mr. Ma, this is our little girl Lei Zhitong. She has decent qualifications and is the true disciple of the head of Changxia Peak. From now on, everyone should get closer to her."

"Dad—" Lei Zhitong coquettishly said, "Ignore you." He turned around and returned to the back room.

Hou Zi stood up and said, "Leader Lei, I'll take my leave now. I have something to send you, so there's no need to see you off."

"Good go, good go." Lei Peng handed over.

Hou Zi turned around and went back to the refining shop.

At the helm of the Dongcheng Gang, Lei Zhitong was sitting upright and Lei Peng was standing at the bottom.

"This person is not simple. He is a mortal. He has no spiritual power fluctuations, but he can dispel the firepower I send out. Have you found out his origin?" Lei Zhitong asked.

"Master Bing, Ma Hou is a pseudonym. His real name is Hou Zi. He was born in Yuezhou City, Gelan Kingdom, Dajing Dynasty. He was an orphan and a street gangster. He was wanted by the King of Yuezhou a month ago. It is understood that two Yunxiao Pavilion monks died in the west mountain of Yuezhou City. The specific reason is unknown."

Lei Peng paused and continued, "Hou Zi was chased into Shiwan Mountain and appeared in Hankou Town and Jiangling City half a month ago. Then he followed Han Bishi, who was actually named Shen Junbi, and came to the Sanxiu Home. Shen Junbi was the former affiliated family of Yunxiao Pavilion.The orphan of the family.Before entering Fang City, he met Shen Biehe, a traitor from the original tribe, and killed him.As for what happened to Hou Zi in Shiwanda Mountain, we can only know that Lu Ji, a foundation-building monk from the upper realm of Yunxiao Pavilion, died in Shiwandashan."

"Foundation Establishment Monk Lu Ji?" Lei Zhitong pondered for a moment, and then ordered Lei Peng, "Is this Hou Zi's real combat power comparable to that of Foundation Establishment? How is this possible in the lower realm? There must be something fishy in it. It cannot be ruled out that he has such strength, which is rare in this lower realm. Let him be a guest. This is the right step. We must win over him and don't ruin our big event."

There was no mention of Ouyang Qi. Could it be that the traces were wiped away by Master Bingyue.

When Hou Zi returned to the weapon refining shop, Shen Junbi greeted him and looked him up and down, "It's okay, nothing missing."

Hou Zi took out the Dongcheng Gang Keqing token, threw it to Shen Junbi and said, "Hey, let's play with it."
